protocol.not_open: The connection sent a request before it opened. Reconnect and try again.
protocol.bad_frame: binference could not read a message from this client. Update the client and try again.
protocol.unknown_op: This version of binference does not know that request. Update binference or the client.
protocol.bad_args: The request leaves something out or holds something wrong. Check what you entered and try again.
protocol.busy: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
protocol.too_large: The request is too large. Split it into smaller parts.
protocol.key_reused: This request repeats an earlier one with different details. Start the action again.
protocol.key_required: This client sent a change without a request id, so binference cannot tell a retry from a new change. Update the client and try again.
protocol.version: This client and binference speak different protocol versions. Update the older one.
auth.required: This client is not signed in. Sign in, then try again.
auth.invalid: Signing in failed. Pair this device again with `binference console`.
auth.expired: Your access expired. Open the console or the Mini App again.
auth.revoked: This device was removed. Pair it again with `binference console`.
auth.origin: This page's address may not connect. Open the console from the link `binference console` prints.
auth.scope: This client may not do that. Use the console or the CLI on the machine.
auth.local_only: This works only on the machine binference runs on. Use the CLI there.
auth.device_only: Only a browser paired as a console device can do this. Open the console in that browser.
engine.starting: binference is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
engine.stopping: binference is shutting down. Start it again with `binference start`.
engine.locked: binference is locked. Run `binference unlock` on the machine.
engine.timeout: binference did not finish in time. Try again.
runtime.unavailable: Your agent is offline right now. Run `binference check` to see why.
agent.not_found: This agent does not exist. Check the list of agents in the console.
agent.archived: This agent is archived. Create a new agent, or pick another one.
agent.frozen: This agent is frozen. Unfreeze it in the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
agent.paper_only: This agent is in paper mode, and this action needs live. Go live with `binference live`.
agent.disclaimer: Accept the disclaimer before going live. Run `binference live` and follow the steps.
agent.file_missing: This agent has no such workspace file. Write the file to create it.
question.not_found: This question does not exist. Answer the agent in the chat instead.
question.closed: This question is closed. Answer the agent in the chat instead.
image.not_found: This image is not in any of the agent's messages. Send the image again in the chat.
image.too_large: This image is over the 5 MiB limit. Send a smaller one.
image.format: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be read. Send the image in one of these formats.
image.unreadable: binference could not fetch this image. Send it again.
agent.budget: This agent used today's model budget. Chat resumes at midnight in your timezone; orders keep running.
market.no_data: No market data source knows this token yet. Check the address, or try again later.
market.source_down: The market data source is not responding. Try again in a minute.
market.no_launch_feed: New launches are not available: this binference is not reading launchpads. Ask for trending tokens instead.
wallet.not_found: This wallet does not exist. Check the list of wallets in the console.
wallet.unfunded: This wallet has no funds yet. Fund it with BNB, then try again.
wallet.bad_owner_key: This owner key does not match the wallet. Check that you entered the right one.
wallet.custody_down: The wallet service is not responding, so nothing was signed. Try again in a minute.
wallet.launch_exists: This agent has a launch wallet already, and an agent holds one at most. See it with `binference wallet list`.
wallet.no_launch_calls: No launchpad this binference runs declares a call on a launch's own contracts, so a launch wallet would allow nothing more than an agent wallet. Enable a launchpad such as Genius.fun in config.json5, then try again.
address.not_found: This address book entry does not exist or was removed. Check the address book in the console.
address.launch_wallet: This address is a launch wallet of this binference, and no wallet may pay one: fund a launch wallet from outside, such as from the rescue address's wallet.
rescue.no_address: Set a rescue address first: run `binference rescue set` with your own wallet's address.
rescue.nothing_to_move: No agent wallet holds anything to rescue.
signer.not_found: No wallet lists this signer. Check the signer ID that `binference init --attach` printed, or the key quorums on Privy's dashboard.
signer.last_signer: This signer is the only one some wallets have, so nothing was removed. Attach the machine that replaces it with `binference init --attach`, which removes this one.
signer.own_key: This is this machine's own agent key, so nothing was removed. Run `binference init --attach` on the machine that replaces this one; it removes this key.
signer.change_expired: A change reached Privy after its expiry, so the wallets after it still list this signer. Run `binference signer revoke` again; it goes on from where it stopped.
intent.not_found: binference has no record of this action. Refresh and try again.
intent.wrong_state: This action already moved on: it was confirmed, cancelled or sent. Refresh to see where it stands.
intent.expired: This action expired before you confirmed it. Ask your agent again.
intent.card_changed: The price moved and the terms changed. Check the new quote, then confirm again.
intent.not_yours: Another client started this action, so this one cannot cancel it. Cancel it in the console or the CLI.
intent.owner_only: Only the owner starts a token launch. Suggest the launch to the owner in chat, with its name, symbol and picture, and let the owner start it.
intent.launch_waiting: Another token launch of this agent is under way, waiting for its pin or the owner's confirmation. Let it finish, or deny its card, before starting the next.
order.not_found: This auto order does not exist. Check your auto orders in the console.
order.wrong_state: This auto order already ended or changed. Refresh to see where it stands.
order.kind_unavailable: This kind of auto order is not available yet. Use a limit, take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop order.
order.unpriced_token: The price watcher cannot price this token now, so a limit, take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop order on it would never fill. It prices a token on its launchpad's bonding curve, or in a PancakeSwap pool that trades at least $1,000 of WBNB or a stablecoin.
note.not_found: This note does not exist. List your agent's notes to see the ones it keeps.
order.live_fills_off: Live auto orders do not fill yet, so binference takes no live limit, take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop order. Place it while the agent is in paper mode.
schedule.not_found: This schedule does not exist or no longer runs. List the agent's schedules to see the ones that run.
schedule.bad_when: binference cannot read when this schedule runs. Give five cron fields, such as 0 9 * * 1-5 for 09:00 on weekdays, a timezone such as Asia/Shanghai, or a future time to run once.
schedule.too_many: This agent already has 50 schedules. Cancel one before you add another.
asset.not_found: binference does not know this token. Paste its contract address instead.
asset.bad_address: This is not a valid address. Check it and paste it again.
asset.unreadable: This token's contract did not give its symbol and decimals, so binference cannot show its amounts on a card. Check the address.
name.not_found: No address is registered for this name. Check the spelling.
name.resolver_down: The name service is not responding. Try again later, or paste the address.
quote.no_route: No route for this trade right now. Try a smaller amount or another token.
quote.venue_down: The venue for this trade is not responding. Try again in a minute.
chain.rpc_down: binference cannot reach the network right now. Try again in a minute, and check your internet connection if it lasts.
chain.simulation_failed: The simulation of this transaction failed, so nothing was sent. Check the amounts and try again.
limit.daily_cap: This trade would take the agent past its 24-hour cap, so it was not confirmed. Wait until earlier trades leave the window, or raise the cap.
limit.needs_admin: A looser limit needs the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
limit.over_ceiling: This limit is above the wallet's ceiling. Raise the ceiling with your owner key first.
limit.venue_in_use: The agent's limits still name a venue this ceiling change removes. Remove the venue from the limits first.
limit.needs_launch_wallet: Live trades on a launch's own curve need a launch wallet. Make one with `binference wallet create --launch`, fund it, then try again.
config.invalid: The config has an error. Run `binference check` to see where and how to fix it.
config.secret_inline: A secret is written as plain text in config. Run `binference check --fix`.
plugin.not_found: This plugin is not installed. Check the list of plugins in the console.
plugin.hash_mismatch: This plugin's files do not match their pinned hash, so it was not loaded. Install it again from its source.
plugin.review_needed: This plugin asks for new permissions. Review them in the console before it runs.
skill.not_found: This agent has no skill of this name, or the skill has no such file. List the agent's skills to see the ones it has.
skill.hash_mismatch: The skill's source does not match its pinned hash, so nothing was installed. Check the hash with the skill's publisher.
skill.refused: This skill was refused: it asks for a secret, runs a download in a shell, sends secrets away or holds one. Nothing was installed.
skill.invalid: This is not a skill binference can install: its SKILL.md, its name or its size is wrong. Nothing was installed.
skill.name_taken: binference ships a skill of this name, so this one was not installed.
skill.fetch_failed: The skill's source could not be fetched. Check its address and that git or npm can reach it, then try again.
job.not_found: This task does not exist or ended long ago. Start it again if you still need it.
backup.no_owner_key: binference holds no owner key to seal a backup to, so none was made. Finish `binference init`, then try again.
backup.snapshot_failed: A database could not be copied, so no backup was made. `binference logs` shows why; fix that, then try again.
backup.write_failed: The backup file could not be written. Check the disk's free space, then try again.
backup.check_failed: Reading the new backup back found a part that does not match, so it was removed. Check the disk, then try again.
backup.copy_failed: The backup was made and checked, but its second copy could not be written. Check the copy folder, then try again.
telegram.not_running: binference is running without its Telegram bot, so no link was made. `binference logs` shows why; fix the bot token, then run `binference restart`.
telegram.unreachable: Telegram could not be reached, so no link was made. Try again in a minute.
token.not_found: No client token has this ID, so nothing was revoked. To remove a client, run `binference mcp setup --remove`.
internal.error: binference hit an internal error. Run `binference report` to make a support file without secrets.
